questionText: When comparing Static and Dynamic test techniques, which of the following statements is TRUE?
options: Static Testing finds failures, whilst Dynamic Testing only finds the cause of failures.
Static Testing techniques, such as reviews, can be undertaken before Dynamic Testing, making defects cheaper to remove.
Static Testing is based on the execution of code, whist Dynamic Testing relies on examination and analysis.
Only Static Testing has the objective of identifying defects.
correctAnswer: Static Testing techniques, such as reviews, can be undertaken before Dynamic Testing, making defects cheaper to remove.
explanation: refer 3.1.2 Khi so sánh các kỹ thuật kiểm tra tĩnh và động, câu nào sau đây là ĐÚNG? Chọn B vì đúng như sách, loại A vì "Static Testing finds failures" failure là phải dynamic test mới tìm ra, loại C vì "Static Testing is based on the execution of code" loại D vì từ "Only"

questionText: One of the roles in a review is that of moderator, which of the following best describes this role?
options: Plans the review, runs the review meeting and ensures that follow-up activities are completed.
Allocates time in the plan, decides which reviews will take place and that the benefits are delivered.
Writes the document to be reviewed, agrees that the document can be reviewed, and updates the document with any changes.
Documents all issues raised in the review meeting, records problems and open points.
correctAnswer: Plans the review, runs the review meeting and ensures that follow-up activities are completed.
explanation: refer 3.2.2. B là của manager, C là của Author, D là recoder nên chọn A là task của moderator

questionText:
Which of the following statements are correct for walkthroughs? 
(i) Often led by the author.
(ii) Documented and defined results.
(iii) All participants have defined roles.
(iv) Used to aid learning.
(v) Main purpose is to find defects.
correctAnswer: (i) and (iv) are correct.
explanation: refer 3.2.4 Câu nào sau đây đúng về walkthrough? thì i đúng và iv đúng ( iv ý nghĩa là để training, education và learning)

questionText: What benefits do static analysis tools have over test execution tools?
options: Static analysis tools find defects earlier in the life cycle
Static analysis tools can be used before code is written.
Static analysis tools test that the delivered code meets business requirements.
Static analysis tools are particularly effective for regression testing.
correctAnswer: Static analysis tools find defects earlier in the life cycle
explanation: Refer 3.1.2 Các công cụ phân tích tĩnh có lợi ích gì so với các công cụ thực hiện kiểm thử? Chọn A vì tìm đc lỗi sớm là đúng, loại B vì "used before code is written" static analysis tool chỉ phân tích trên các sản phẩm có cấu trúc như code, mà nếu chưa có code thì làm sao bật tool để phân tích, C sai vì "meets business requirements" cái này phải của review tìm ra, loại D vì "regression testing" là của dynamic test

questionText:
You are reading a user story in the product backlog to prepare for a meeting with the product
owner and a developer, noting potential defects as you go. Which TWO of the following statements is
true about this activity?
options: It is not a static test, because static testing involves execution of the test object
It is not a static test, because static testing is always performed using a tool
It is a static test, because any defects you find could be found cheaper during dynamic testing
It is a static test, because static testing does not involve execution of the test object
correctAnswer: It is a static test, because any defects you find could be found cheaper during dynamic testing
It is a static test, because static testing does not involve execution of the test object
explanation: Refer 3.1.3. Hai cái nào đúng về việc mà bạn "reading a user story"? đây là 1 hoạt động review nên nó là static test là chắc chắn, đúng nhất theo định nghĩa là D review thì "not involve execution of the test object", đúng thứ nhì là C nó giúp tìm ra lỗi rẻ hơn dynamic testing

questionText: Which TWO of the following statements on the use of checklists in a formal review is CORRECT?
options: As part of the review planning, the reviewers create the checklists needed for the review
As part of the individual review, the reviewers fill in the checklists provided for the review
As part of the review meeting, the reviewers create defect reports based on the checklists provided for the review
As part of the review initiation, the reviewers receive the checklists needed for the review
correctAnswer: As part of the individual review, the reviewers fill in the checklists provided for the review
As part of the review initiation, the reviewers receive the checklists needed for the review
explanation: Refer 3.2.1 Review process. Đáp án D đùng vì nhiệm vụ của Initiate reivew ( kick-off) thì phân phát các tài liệu và material cho reviewers, thì trong đó reviewer cũng nhận đc checklist để review. Và đáp án B mình sửa là trong giai đoạn individual review ( cá nhân tự chuẩn bị cho review) thì họ sẽ fill kết quả vào checklist những comments hoặc defects mà họ tìm đc là đúng. (nếu đề thi để là trong Review Meeting mới fill thông tin vào checklist thì cũng tạm chấp nhận đc.) Còn A sai vì planning ko có nhiệm vụ của reviewer ( đây là nhiệm vụ của moderator). C sai vì tạo defect report là nhiệm vụ của Fixing and Reporting

questionText:
Decide which of the following statements (i-v) are true for static testing.
i. Abnormal external behaviors are easier to identify with this testing
ii. Discrepancies from a coding standard are easier to find with this testing
iii. It identifies failures caused by defects when the software is run
iv. Its test objective is to identify defects as early as possible
v. Missing coverage for critical security requirements is easier to find and fix
options: i, iv, v are true for static testing
i, iii, iv are true for static testing
ii, iii are true for static testing
ii, iv, v are true for static testing
correctAnswer: ii, iv, v are true for static testing
explanation: Refer 3.1.3. Chú ý vào ii đúng vì "Discrepancies from a coding standard", v đúng vì "security requirements",  iv đúng vì " identify defects as early as" còn lại các cái khác sai vì i sai vì "behaviors" của dynamic, iii sai vì " identifies failures" của dynamic

questionText: What task may management take on during a formal review?
options: Taking overall responsibility for the review
Deciding what is to be reviewed
Ensuring the effective running of review meetings, and mediating, if necessary
Recording review information such as review decisions
correctAnswer: Deciding what is to be reviewed
explanation: Refer 3.2.2 roles and responsibility. B là của management, còn lại A, C,D là của moderator,

questionText: Which of following review types has its purpose of discussing, making decisions, evaluation alternatives, solving technical problems and checking conformance to specifications, plans, regulations and standards? [K2]
correctAnswer: Technical Review
explanation: Refer 3.2.3 Bạn chú ý vào đoạn "solving technical problems and checking conformance to specifications" kỹ thuật mà xử lý các vấn đề về kỹ thuật, kiểm tra xem có thỏa mãn với tài liệu đặc tả hay ko thì là Technical Review rồi

questionText:
You are performing a review, how many comments do you find based on checklist?
The Test Cases are as follows:
TC1. Success - valid 'User Name' and 'Password'; Customer Menu displayed 
TC2. Failure - 'User Name' field has blank entry; Error Number 12 displayed 
TC3. Failure - 'User Id' entered does not exist on database (i.e. unregistered user); Error Number 23 displayed
 TC4. Failure - 'Password' entered does not match user's password on database; Error Number 24 displayed 
You are guided by the following checklist in your review:
C1. There must be one test case to cover success
C2. There must be one test case for each error path ( validation failure) 
C3. Each test case must use terminology consistent with the test basis document (field names, error number)
explanation: Refer 3.2 Câu hỏi là bạn tìm đc bao nhiêu comments dựa vào checklist khi review test case của đồng nghiệp. Comment gồm có: TC1, TC3 bị sai vì "Customer Menu" và "'User Id' không có trong màn hình đặc tả, và thiếu 1 test case cho trường hợp Blank password

questionText: When comparing Static and Dynamic test techniques, which of the following statements is TRUE?
options: Static Testing finds failures, whilst Dynamic Testing only finds the cause of failures.
Only Static Testing has the objective of identifying defects.
Static Testing techniques, such as reviews, can be undertaken before Dynamic Testing, making defects cheaper to remove.
Static Testing is based on the execution of code, whist Dynamic Testing relies on examination and analysis.
correctAnswer: Static Testing techniques, such as reviews, can be undertaken before Dynamic Testing, making defects cheaper to remove.
explanation: refer 3.1.2 tìm được C đúng. A sai vì Static Testing finds failures ( failure là phải khi chạy), B sai vì Only, D sai vì Static Testing is based on the execution of code

questionText: Which defect below is MOST likely to be found by a review during static testing?
options: Old versions of software in use.
correctAnswer: Incorrect interface specifications.
explanation: Refer 3.1.3 typical defects tìm đc review là chủ yếu trong tài liệu. B là của configuration management, C, D là của dynamic test

questionText: What benefits do static analysis tools have over test execution tools?
options: Static analysis tools find defects earlier in the life cycle.
Static analysis tools can be used before code is written.
Static analysis tools test that the delivered code meets business requirements.
Static analysis tools are particularly effective for regression testing.
correctAnswer: Static analysis tools find defects earlier in the life cycle.
explanation: Refer 3.1.2 Value của Static testing là tìm thấy lỗi sớm trước Dynamic test. B sai vì static analysis tool chủ yếu phân tích trên code. C sai vì "meets business requirements." là của Review. D sai vì "regression testing" là của Dynamic test

questionText: One of the roles in a review is that of moderator, which of the following best describes this role?
options: Plans the review, runs the review meeting and ensures that follow-up activities are completed.
Allocates time in the plan, decides which reviews will take place and that the benefits are delivered.
Writes the document to be reviewed, agrees that the document can be reviewed, and updates the document with any changes.
Documents all issues raised in the review meeting, records problems and open points.
correctAnswer: Plans the review, runs the review meeting and ensures that follow-up activities are completed.
explanation: Refer 3.2.3 các vai trò của review. A là của Moderator còn gọi là Leader của review, B là của manager ra quyết định và cấp phép, C là của Author, D là Scribe

questionText: What do static analysis tools analyze?
correctAnswer: Program code
explanation: Refer 3.1.3 ba đáp án A,B,C sai là tài liệu chỉ có thể do Review tìm ra lỗi.

questionText: Which of the following is most likely to be a benefit of using static techniques?
options: Productivity improvements in the development process.
Quick return on investment in static analysis tools.
correctAnswer: Productivity improvements in the development process.
explanation: Refer 3.1.2 thì thấy B đúng, static test giúp cải thiện productivity, giảm thời gian và giảm chi phí. A,C là lỗi của dynamic, D là nhanh trả ra giá trị đầu tư là không có

questionText: Which of the following are static techniques?
correctAnswer: Walkthrough.
explanation: Refer 3.2.4 kỹ thuật static techniques không chạy source code là A. B,C,D sai vì là của Dynamic test

questionText: Which one of the following roles is typically used in a review?
correctAnswer: Author.
explanation: Refer 3.2.3 Vai trò của review chỉ có B đúng

questionText:
Which of the following statements are correct for walkthroughs?
(i) Often led by the author.
(ii) Documented and defined results.
(iii) All participants have defined roles.
(iv) Used to aid learning.
(v) Main purpose is to find defects.
correctAnswer: (i) and (iv) are correct.
explanation: Refer 3.2.4 Review types thì walkthough có (i) lead by author và (iv) để training. và ii, iii, v là đặc điểm của inspection

questionText: Which of the following has the typical formal review activities in the correct sequence?
options: Planning, kick-off, individual preparation, review meeting.
correctAnswer: Planning, kick-off, individual preparation, review meeting.
explanation: Refer 3.2.2 review process

questionText:
Which of the following statements are true?
(i) Defects are likely to be found earlier in the development process by using reviews rather than static analysis.
(ii) Walkthroughs require code but static analysis does not require code.
(iii) Informal reviews can be performed on code and specifications.
(iv) Dynamic techniques are generally used before static techniques.
(v) Dynamic techniques can only be used after code is ready to be executed.
explanation: Refer 3.1.2 và loại trừ ii sai vì walkthrough là hình thức reiview không thay đc tool phân tích code ( review ko hết đc code). iv sai vì dynamic chạy trước static

questionText: An important benefit of code inspections is that they
options: enable the code to be tested before the execution environment is ready.
can be performed by the person who wrote the code.
can be performed by inexperienced staff.
correctAnswer: enable the code to be tested before the execution environment is ready.
explanation: refer 3.1.2, chính là lợi ích của static testing ( inspection là hình thức của review). A đúng vì static giúp cho việc kiểm tra code trước khi chạy ( tìm thấy lỗi trước dynamic)

questionText: Which of the following statements about reviews is true?
options: Reviews cannot be performed on user requirements specifications.
Reviews are the least effective way of testing code.
Reviews are unlikely to find faults in test plans.
Reviews should be performed on specifications, code, and test plans.
correctAnswer: Reviews should be performed on specifications, code, and test plans.
explanation: refer 3.1.3 Review sử dụng cho mọi loại tài liệu

questionText: Increasing the quality of the software, by better development methods, will affect the time needed for testing (the test phases) by
correctAnswer: reducing test time
explanation: refer 3.1.2, chú ý vào "better development methods" phương pháp phát triển tốt hơn thì phải giúp giảm thời gian và chi phí

questionText: Inspections can find all the following except?
options: Requirements that have been omitted from the design documents
Spelling and grammar faults in the documents
Variables not defined in the code
How much of the code has been covered
correctAnswer: How much of the code has been covered
explanation: Refer 3.2.2 câu hỏi là Inspection tìm ra tất cả lỗi trừ cái nào sau đây. D là của dynamic test còn inspection là của static testing

questionText: Which statement about Static Testing is TRUE?
options: Static testing can be applied to any work product that participants know how to read and understand.
Static testing must only be applied to final work products that have been signed off.
Static testing must be conducted by users of the product being tested.
Static testing executes the code to verify the functionality is as expected.
correctAnswer: Static testing can be applied to any work product that participants know how to read and understand.
explanation: refer 3.1.1 Cái nào đúng về Static testing? chọn A đúng, loại B vì "must only be applied to final work products" chỉ áp dụng trên sản phẩm cuối cùng, C sai vì "conducted by users", D sai vì "Static testing executes the code"

questionText: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Pair programming is done with developer and tester pairing together
Pair programming is used usually in waterfall model
Pair programming is, among other things, an informal review method
correctAnswer: Pair programming is, among other things, an informal review method
explanation: refer 3.2.3 review types (Pair programming là pair review)

questionText: Which of the following is a defect that is more likely to be found by a static analysis tool than by other testing techniques?
options: Variables that are not used improperly declared
correctAnswer: Variables that are not used improperly declared
explanation: refer 3.1.3 lỗi tìm đc bới static analysis tool là chủ yếu trong code

questionText: Which of the following type of defect would NOT be typically found by using a static analysis tool?
options: A variable is defined but is then not used
A variable is used in a calculation before it is defined
A variable has the wrong numeric value passed into it
A variable is used but not declared
correctAnswer: A variable has the wrong numeric value passed into it
explanation: refer 3.1.3, tất cả các lỗi đều nằm trong code nhưng chọn C vì nó quá cụ thể về "the wrong numeric value" không phải lúc nào giá trị test cũng là dạng số

text: Which of the following is an extension of equivalence partitioning?
correctAnswer: Boundary value analysis
explanation: Refer 4.2.1 và 4.2.2

text: If test cases are derived from looking at the code, what type of test design technique is being used?
correctAnswer: White-box
explanation: Refer 4.1.2 nhìn cái bảng so sánh đó và chú ý vào "from looking at the code"

text: Which of the following is a Black Box test design technique?
correctAnswer: Equivalence Partitioning
explanation: Refer 4.1.2

text: Which of the following would be a good test technique to use when under severe time pressure?
correctAnswer: Exploratory testing
explanation: Refer 4.4.2 và chú ý vào "under severe time pressure- dưới áp lực về thời gian" thì test nào nhanh và hiệu quả nhất sẽ áp dụng

text: A thermometer measures temperature in whole degrees only. If the temperature falls below 18 degrees, the heating is switched off. It is switched on again when the temperature reaches 21 degrees. What are the best values in degrees to cover all equivalence partitions?
explanation: Refer 4.2.2. Tự vẽ ra sơ đồ nhé

text:
Which of the following are white-box test design techniques? 
a) Decision table testing. 
b) Decision coverage. 
c) Boundary value analysis. 
d) Error guessing.
e) Statement testing.
correctAnswer: b and e
explanation: Refer 4.1.2

text:
A garden irrigation system allows the user to specify 2 inputs: 
1. Frequency - The number of times the system should be automatically switched on per day; minimum once per day, maximum 5 times 
2. Duration - The duration of operation, in whole minutes, each time it is switched on; ranging from 1 to 60 Applying 2-value boundary value analysis which of the following options has the correct test set of valid and invalid boundary values?
options: Frequency 0, 1, 5, 6; Duration 59 seconds, 1 minute, 60 minutes, 60 minutes 1 second
correctAnswer: Frequency 0, 1, 5, 6; Duration 59 seconds, 1 minute, 60 minutes, 60 minutes 1 second
explanation: Refer 4.2.2 BVA, thực chất là xác định BVA của 2 cái input, trong đó duration tính theo minute nhưng dưới minute là second nữa

text: Which of the following is an experience-based testing technique?
correctAnswer: Error guessing
explanation: Refer 4.1.2

text: Which of the following test techniques uses the requirements specifications as a test basis?
correctAnswer: Black-box
explanation: Refer 4.1.2 chú ý "uses the requirements specifications"

text: Which of the following is a good reason to use experience-based testing?
options: You can find defects that might be missed by more formal techniques
You can test for defects that only experienced users would encounter
You can target the developer’s efforts to the areas that users will be more likely to use
It is supported by strong tools and can be automated
correctAnswer: You can find defects that might be missed by more formal techniques
explanation: Refer 4.1.2 chọn A vì "might be missed by more formal techniques" có trong sách, kỹ thuật theo kinh nghiệm giúp tìm các lỗi bỏ sót bởi các kỹ thuật khác

text:
You have designed test cases to provide 100% statement and 100% decision coverage for the following fragment of code. 
if width > length then biggest_dimension = width 
else biggest_dimension = length 
end_if 
The following has been added to the bottom of the code fragment above. 
print "Biggest dimension is " & biggest_dimension 
print "Width: " & width print "Length: " & length 
How many more test cases are required?
options: One more test case will be required for 100 % decision coverage.
Two more test cases will be required for 100 % statement coverage, one of which will be used to provide 100% decision coverage.
None, existing test cases can be used.
One more test case will be required for 100% statement coverage.
correctAnswer: None, existing test cases can be used.
explanation: Refer 4.3.1. Cái này vẽ sơ đồ ra, chú ý là họ đã có Test case và bao phủ "100% statement and 100% decision coverage", giờ họ viết thêm 2 dòng code vào phần cuối của chương trình thì nó vẫn là lệnh khẳng định nên các TC đã có vẫn đi qua hết các lệnh này nên ta ko cần thêm TC nữa

text:
Given the following fragment of code, how many tests are required for 100% decision coverage? 
if width > length then biggest_dimension = width 
if height > width then biggest_dimension = height 
end_if 
else biggest_dimension = length 
if height > length then biggest_dimension = height 
end_if 
end_if
explanation: Refer 4.2.2 vẽ ra để xác định

text: If you are using error guessing to target your testing, which type of testing are you doing?
correctAnswer: Experience-based
explanation: Refer 4.1.2 và chú ý "using error guessing"

text: How is statement coverage determined?
options: Number of test decision points divided by the number of test cases
Number of decision outcomes tested divided by the total number of executable statements
Number of possible test case outcomes divided by the total number of function points
Number of executable statements tested divided by the total number of executable statements
correctAnswer: Number of executable statements tested divided by the total number of executable statements
explanation: Refer 4.3.1 định nghĩa công thức tính statement coverage

text: What is error guessing?
options: A testing technique used to guess where a developer is likely to have made a mistake
A technique used for assessing defect metrics
A development technique to verify that all error paths have been coded
A planning technique used to anticipate likely schedule variances due to faults
correctAnswer: A testing technique used to guess where a developer is likely to have made a mistake
explanation: Refer 4.4.1 và chọn A vì "a mistake" dựa vào sai sót chung của LTV. Loại D vì "A planning technique" là kỹ thuật lập kế hoạch ko phải của test, loại C vì "A development technique" là kỹ thuật của LTV ko phải test, Loại B vì cũng ko phải kỹ thuật test

text: When exploratory testing is conducted using time-boxing and test charters, what is it called?
correctAnswer: Session-based testing
explanation: Refer 4.4.2 và chú ý vào "using time-boxing and test charters" để tìm ra trong sách

text:
You are testing an e-commerce transaction that has the following states and transitions: 
1. Login (invalid) > Login 
2. Login > Search 
3. Search > Search 
4. Search > Shopping Cart 
5. Shopping Cart > Search 
6. Shopping Cart > Checkout 
7. Checkout > Search 
8. Checkout > Logout 
For a state transition diagram, how many transitions should be shown?
explanation: Refer 4.2.4 state transition testing, nên vẽ sơ đồ ra rồi đếm số transition.

text: You are testing a banking application that allows a customer to withdraw 20, 100 or 500 dollars in a single transaction. The values are chosen from a drop-down list and no other values may be entered. How many equivalence partitions need to be tested to achieve 100% equivalence partition coverage?
explanation: Refer 4.2.1 EP, và "a drop-down list and no other values" nên ta có 3 value của drop down list và 1 giá trị là ko nhập gì mà ấn enter luôn là tổng 4 value

text: An automated air-conditioner is programmed to turn its heating unit on when the temperature falls below 17 and to turn its refrigeration unit on when the temperature exceeds 26. The air- conditioner is designed to operate at temperatures between -10 and +40. Given the above specification, which of the following sets of values shows that the equivalence partition test design technique has been used correctly?
explanation: Refer 4.2.1 EP bạn phải vẽ đúng sơ đồ

text: If you are testing a module of code, how do you determine the level of decision coverage you have achieved?
options: By taking the number of decisions you have tested and dividing that by the total number of executable statements in the module
By taking the number of decisions you have tested and dividing that by the total number of decisions in the module
By taking the number of decisions you have tested and dividing that by the total lines of code in the module
By taking the number of decision outcomes you have tested and dividing that by the total number of decision outcomes in the module
correctAnswer: By taking the number of decision outcomes you have tested and dividing that by the total number of decision outcomes in the module
explanation: Refer 4.3.2 định nghĩa của decision coverage

text: (V4.0 bỏ câu này) Which of the following best describes the behaviors defined in a use case that should be covered by tests?
options: Control flow, data flow and decision paths
correctAnswer: Basic, exception and error
explanation: Refer 4.2.5 xem định nghĩa của use case chọn B. Loại D vì của whitebox test, A là category của test case, test data, Loại C vì ko có cái nào liên quan đến use case

text: You are testing a machine that scores exam papers and assigns grades. Based on the score achieved the grades are as follows: 1-49 = F, 50-59 = D-, 60-69 = D, 70-79 = C, 80-89 = B, 90-100=A If you apply equivalence partitioning, how many test cases will you need to achieve minimum test coverage?
explanation: Refer 4.2.1 EP, vẽ ra ta có 6 EP valid và thêm 2 EP invalid là nhỏ hơn 1 và lớn hơn 100 nữa

text: You are testing a machine that scores exam papers and assigns grades. Based on the score achieved the grades are as follows: 1-49 = F, 50-59 = D-, 60-69 = D, 70-79 = C, 80-89 = B, 90-100=A If you apply two-value boundary value analysis, how many test cases will you need to achieve minimum test coverage?
explanation: Refer 4.2.2 BVA, vẽ ra và xác định BVA

text:
A program validates a numeric field as follows: 
values less than 10 are rejected, 
values between 10 and 21 are accepted, 
values greater than or equal to 22 are rejected.
 Which of the following input values cover Most of the difference equivalence partitions?
explanation: Refer 4.2.1 vẽ ra

text: You have been given the following requirement: A user must log in to the system with a valid username and password. If they fail to enter the correct combination three times, they will receive an error and will have to wait 10 minutes before trying again. The test terminates when the user successfully logs in. How many test cases are needed to provide 100% state transition coverage?
explanation: Câu này phải vẽ sơ đồ state transition ra nhé (nhìn vào hình mình vẽ cho rồi đó), nó là dạng login trên trình duyệt, nhiều bạn đọc đề cứ thế lấy hình của ATM là không đúng đâu. Xem video chữa đề

text: You have been given the following conditions and results from those condition combinations. You can only have one form of payment. A PIN is only needed for a debit card. Given this information, using the decision table technique, what is the minimum number of test cases you would need to test these conditions?
explanation: Refer 4.2.3 tự vẽ ra bảng thu gọn Decision table
